message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a 3D puzzle wall art kit. The kit is a set of printed paperboard pieces assembled into a decorative wall hanging. The candidate headings are:

- 4911.91 (other printed matter, pictures and designs).
- 9503.00 (toys, puzzles). The "3D puzzle" label points here, but the item is wall decor rather than a toy.
- 4814 (wallpaper), which does not fit.
- 4823.90 (other paper cut to shape).
- 4905 (maps), which does not fit.
- 4911.99 (other printed matter).

I recall a ruling for "Wall Pops DIY Layered Wall Art Kit" that classified it under 4911.91.40 as printed pictures, designs and photographs. 4911.91.40 covers "Other: Pictures, designs and photographs: Other: Printed not over 20 years at time of importation." I believe the statistical suffix is 4911.91.4040 ("Other"), so I will go with that. The alternative of 9503.00.0090 is not as strong because the kit's use is decorative.

{"hts_code": "4911.91.4040", "reason": "The printed, die-cut paperboard kit assembles into decorative three-dimensional wall art, so it is classified as other printed pictures and designs of heading 4911 rather than as a toy puzzle."}
